fillInstructions.description: The removed white '2' should be filled with the orange interior of the top-left badge, matching its smooth radial/diagonal gradient (slightly lighter toward the upper-left, deeper orange toward the lower-right). No other symbols pass behind it.
continueEdges: Continue the badge’s internal orange gradient seamlessly through the numeral cutout

fillInstructions.texture: Flat, clean vector-like fill with very subtle gradient shading and no grain.
